remarks: Welcome to 99 Prospect Street - Prospect/Grove Condominiums. One of Stamford's most popular & affordable residences, whether you're an Owner or Landlord. The location is superb, in the heart of Downtown Stamford. Well maintained buildings & common areas. Heat, Hot Water & Cooking Gas included in HOA fees with an assigned parking space, too. Pretty & tastefully decorated, this 600+ sqft unit with, foyer, kitchen, good size bedroom modern bath, tall spacious closets & the occupant is selling their creative bookcase/shelving in the bedroom and the breakfast bar for the kitchen. 2 AC wall units for the summer months, clean common laundry room. A really nice place to live!
